positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● A motion triggered sensor with customized reminder notifications alert. Remind users in various situations such as the mailbox just opened, forgetting to close the door or bring an umbrella.
● Implement features, troubleshoot, fixing bugs on Android device using Kotlin and Android Studio
● Beautify and clean up the front-end of the app. Adapt Google Material UI to the existing layout.
● Collaborate with an experienced engineer leader at all aspects of the application development, write
quality and well documented code.
● Conduct tests before every weekly release, identify potential bugs from edge cases and performance
issues, and propose solutions.

positions.title: Flutter Developer
positions.description:
Halen is a user friendly, community based super app. Providing convenient services including ride-share, food, grocery, and retail delivery. As well as flight booking and vacation rentals.
● Work on two different versions of Halen (customer and driver) for both iOS and Android platforms using Flutter as a hybrid solution.
● Responsible for the deployment of Halen’s apps on Google Play Store.
● Involved in the entire software development process: Requirement Specification, Design, Implementation, and testing.
● Collaborate in a team of 3 to develop interface and overall Halen’s apps.
● Used Flutter Provider state management to handle all the interactions between UI and logic.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
A tool to help American navigate the US healthcare system.
● Successfully launched on Playstore, achieved top 50 at Google Solution Challenge
● Build a prototype with Flutter, design beautiful UI/UX, live demo for users and experts, gather feedback
and insight, design wireframe, and evaluate features. Collaborate with experts on the content.
● Automatically gather hospital data with Python web scraping and Google API, store in Google BigQuery,
connect to the front-end with Google Cloud Function.
● Conduct unit and integration tests, release for internal tests on the Play Store.
● Design metrics to evaluate features in the app, measure and analyze with Firebase Analytics.
● Weekly meeting with mentor - Product Manager at Google. Build the direction and vision for the project
● Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.patienceteam.healthcarenavigator

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Organize events, create an environment for all students to study about Google technologies. Host game
nights and info sessions
Prepare technical materials and demos for workshops, collaborator of Intro to Google Solution Challenge 2021.

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
Collaborate with the back-end team to create the structure for the database. The designing based on data type of each entry, the client’s requirement and app’s features.
I implement the query commands, to query and return the specific result the app wants to display.
I configure all the end-point with Amazon API Gateway, which is the interaction between client app and database, including writing a new record, updating an existing record, returning a single record, or returning records with filters(query), and deleting a record. Each interaction will have its own end-point and method.
I write a small package, using Javascript for the front-end team. The small package contains all the interaction with DynamoDB, linked to API Gateway’s specific end-point, through a secured API key. This will save a lot of time for the front-end, they can simply receive the data with a simple call function.
